title: What If We Nuked a Hurricane?

scenes.text: What if we nuked a hurricane? People have asked for decades. NOAA has an answer.
A hurricane releases heat equal to a ten-megaton bomb going off every twenty minutes.
The largest nuclear weapon ever tested was about fifty megatons, one blast, and then it's over.
To weaken a Category 5 to a Category 2, you'd have to add about half a billion tons of air to the eye.
Meanwhile, the fallout would drift with the trade winds toward land.
Of about eighty tropical disturbances a year in the Atlantic, only five or so become hurricanes. And nobody can tell which.

description:
What if we nuked a hurricane?
NOAA says a hurricane releases the heat of a ten-megaton bomb every twenty minutes, and a blast would add fallout without stopping the storm.
